## Purpose 
Fixing build kite examples. Some of the build kite jobs run but the artifacts are not in the specified directories. This PR fixes that. Also, in the produced plots the axis limits change in time. In this PR we fix limits to the minimum and maximum in time to more clearly see how the curves vary in time.
